verdicts.reason: Both crush the decorative triangles and the wind-turbine icon into a cramped cluster at the left. The icon is shrunk to an illegible speck, the shapes are cropped into meaningless fragments, the red triangle sits almost against the headline, and the stray diagonal lines leave the right side mostly empty and unbalanced. B is marginally better because its headline is larger, its icon is slightly more readable and the triangle has a little more clearance from the text. A's red triangle almost touches the 'E' of ENERGY.
